name: P-008 native expired pairing recovery and fresh pairing
summary: The maintained native Mac VM iPhone simulator runner passed 60 unit tests, 5 UI smoke tests, and the selected expired-pair/fresh-pair UI test with zero failures and zero skips. The expired code displayed recovery guidance, ordinary relaunch remained unpaired, a fresh code paired and showed the authorized Operator tab, and a subsequent Keychain relaunch retained the paired state. All 279 declared native artifacts were rehashed from the retained archive with zero mismatches; the disposable fixture and private inputs were removed and cleanup was verified.

The fixture runtime receipt records processCleanupVerified, cloudCleanupVerified and cleanupVerified true. Guest private pair inputs, fixture HOME and both fixture ports were absent after shutdown.
